question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who enjoys doing dangerous things, in a way that other people may think is stupid.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Daredevil."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **'daredevil'** is a one-word substitute for a person who enjoys doing dangerous things.
 
• **'डेयरडेविल'** शब्द उस व्यक्ति के लिए एक शब्द का विकल्प है जिसे खतरनाक काम करने में आनंद आता है।
 
• It is derived from the words 'dare' (meaning to challenge) and 'devil' (referring to someone who is daring or reckless).
 
 
• **Example:** *The **daredevil**__ performed a dangerous stunt on his motorcycle.*
 
 
 
• A person who enjoys doing dangerous things, in a way that other people may think is stupid is called **"Daredevil."**
 
• ​So, the correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Cavalier" **Showing a lack of proper concern; offhand or dismissive (बेपरवाह, लापरवाह)
 
• **"Lunatic"** refers to someone who is mentally ill or crazy**. (**कोई व्यक्ति जो मानसिक रूप से बीमार या पागल हो)
 
• **"Gallant"** refers to someone who is brave or chivalrous. (कोई व्यक्ति जो बहादुर या शूरवीर हो)
